title: The engine configuration
description: Everything the unattended writing engine knows about the site it runs on. Every field is required and none has a default.

schema.description: The version of this file's shape, 1.

proseDirectories.description: Directories from the repository root, each ending in a slash, whose files never change what a gate measures: documents, audit records, skills, specs.

proseExtensions.description: File extensions, each with its dot, that mark prose when the file sits outside a shipped directory.

shippedDirectories.description: Directories from the repository root, each ending in a slash, whose files reach the built site, markdown included.

automationDirectories.description: Directories from the repository root, each ending in a slash, that hold workflows and hooks: they change how gates run and never what the build emits.

testTooling.description: Files from the repository root that configure the test runners, so they cannot change the build.

testFilePattern.description: A regular expression, tested against the whole path from the repository root, that marks a test file.

testDirectoryPattern.description: A regular expression, tested against the whole path from the repository root, that marks a directory of tests or fixtures outside a shipped directory.

rules.description: Checked in order: the first prefix a route starts with names its family (the title grammar) and its profile (the content gate), so the longer prefix goes first.

fallback.description: The family and profile of a route that no prefix claims.

dataDirectory.description: Directory from the repository root that holds one subdirectory of markdown entries per collection.

term.description: Where a glossary term is written and the route prefix it is served under.

article.description: Where a blog article is written, the route prefix it is served under, the author it names and the collection of resources it may link to.

formats.description: The two formats the unattended writer produces.

attemptCap.description: Most repair attempts one article gets before the loop escalates.

quarantineHours.description: Hours a pull request waits after it opens before the watcher may merge it.

monthlySpendCeilingUsd.description: US dollars of model spend allowed in one calendar month; reaching it stops the workflow.

claimLifetimeDays.description: Days a committed topic claim holds its title and slug before it lapses.

holdLabel.description: The pull request label that stops the watcher from merging.

property.description: The Search Console property the demand report reads, for example sc-domain:example.com. Not a secret: it names the site, and the service-account key is what grants access.

windowDays.description: Days of Search Console data one demand report covers.

dataLagDays.description: Days before today at which the window ends, because Search Console data arrives late.

maxAgeDays.description: Days after which the committed demand report is too old to choose a topic from.

minImpressions.description: Impressions a query needs before it counts as demand.

min.description: Best average position at which a page counts as already ranking.

max.description: Worst average position at which a page counts as already ranking.

strengthenBand.description: Average positions between which a page already ranks, so the query strengthens that page and is not a reason for a new one.

directory.description: A directory from the repository root, ending in a slash.

path.description: A path from the repository root, without a trailing slash.

routePrefix.description: A route prefix, starting with a slash.

family.description: The route family, which picks the title grammar.

profile.description: The content-gate profile the page is judged against.

prefix.description: The prefix a route starts with.

family.description: The route family, which picks the title grammar.

profile.description: The content-gate profile the page is judged against.

collection.description: The collection the entry is written into.

routePrefix.description: The route prefix the entry's page is served under.

collection.description: The collection the entry is written into.

routePrefix.description: The route prefix the entry's page is served under.

author.description: The slug of the author entry that every written article names.

resourceCollection.description: The collection of resources an article may link to, which holds neither terms nor articles.
